current_choice.role: prospective primary for a new, separately frozen experiment
current_choice.definition: Choice in a new same-scope scenario using preferences effective at explicit source_cutoff.
current_choice.exclusions: Not an exemption from latest changes or conditional limits; no demographic/default-personality guessing.

historical_reconstruction.role: independent diagnostic, never removed from D0015 or silently pooled away
historical_reconstruction.definition: Recover a choice or fact at a specified earlier time.
historical_reconstruction.interpretation: A current-only representation may intentionally be non-identifying for a past query; report this loss explicitly.

scoring.primary: Correct categorical choices / all16 planned current queries per person; failures remain.
scoring.diagnostic: Correct / all8 planned historical queries per person; always reported alongside primary.
scoring.joint_reporting: Also report unweighted correct/all24 and worst critical layer; never substitute a successful subset for D0015.
scoring.pairing: Both twins must be correct on their differing scenarios; both option orders must preserve action.
scoring.abstention: U is credited only for a code-defined unknown, never for a missing output.
scoring.quality_vs_cost: Full rendered memory length and all extraction/compression/reader costs stay separate.

gates.promotion: No winner claim from current-score gain alone if any critical layer regresses or hard errors appear; historical losses remain visible.

reader_instruction: Predict the synthetic person’s choice from supplied memory, not your preferred solution. Memory may be ordinary prose, a timeline or structured text: dates and record IDs are not required formatting for an otherwise supported current choice. The envelope states source_cutoff; current_choice means a new scenario evaluated with preferences effective at that cutoff. Respect conditions, hard constraints, evidence strength, explicit changes and revocations; current explicit user instructions override past preference. Do not execute any option. For historical_reconstruction, require information that identifies the state at the requested past time; an unanchored current statement alone is insufficient. Choose U when the supplied memory genuinely does not establish a choice, not solely because it lacks record syntax. Return one object mapping every query ID to an answer_options ID. No hidden truth is supplied.
D0015: All original scores, denominators, queries and answers remain sealed. These fixtures are development, not a new model result.
limitations: Finite authored event ontology and explicit source coverage; not an arbitrary person or population.
Code-only answerability/format controls do not predict actual model response to a prompt repair.
All future model inputs, cohort, protocol, budgets and thresholds must be frozen before new inference.
